description: Return the actual due dates for periodic Israeli reporting and payment — VAT and income-tax advances, income-tax withholding, the detailed VAT report, and National Insurance where the year's notice covers it — with the reason for any postponement. Approved calendars: 2026, from the Tax Authority notice of 15.10.2025, verified by a CPA; and 2027, from the notice of 13.10.2026, which sets no National Insurance dates. Defaults to 2026 until 01.01.2027, then 2027. Filter by workflow, obligation or reporting month. Years without an approved calendar, and annual returns, return no dates and say so.

obligation.description: One periodic obligation; overrides the workflow mapping.

period_month.description: Reporting period month (1 = January). The due date falls in the following month.

tax_year.description: Tax year of the reporting periods. Approved calendars: 2026, from the Tax Authority notice of 15.10.2025, and 2027, from the notice of 13.10.2026. Defaults to 2026 until 01.01.2027, then 2027. National Insurance dates exist for 2026 only — the 2027 notice does not set them. Other years return no dates.

workflow.description: Filing workflow. vat-reporting → VAT/advances and the detailed VAT report; withholding-reporting → income-tax withholding. Omit (with no obligation) for all periodic obligations.
